# Mod by Gravitr for *Robin Hood: The Legend of Sherwood*

- Original source: [Mod by Gravitr](https://www.moddb.com/mods/mod-by-gravitr) on ModDB
- Creator: Gravitr
- Publication: Released 2021 (page metadata date: April 27, 2021)
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Source language: English
- Coverage: Main summary page and comments 1–10 of 12 (page 1 of 2); page 2 was not included in the mapped source files.

## Description

Custom game modification I created for this great old game.

[Embedded video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9Lr7rOCz5qY) (the source page embeds this video).

### List of changes

#### Game

- Various enemy levels in all maps (mixed colors)
- Increased all units HP for each difficulty level
- Increased ally melee units HP and attack rate (green color units)
- Added widescreen resolution profiles (16:9, 16:10)

#### Maps

- Map 01 (Lincoln) - changed time from Day to Fog
- Map 02 (Nottingham) - changed time from Day to Night
- Map 03 (Leicester) - changed time from Night to Day
- Map 04 (Nottingham) - changed time from Night to Day
- Map 06 (Leicester) - changed time from Day to Night
- Map 07 (Lincoln) - changed time from Night to Day
- Map 11 (York) - changed time from Day to Night
- Map 12 (Nottingham) - changed time from Fog to Night
- Map 13 (York) - changed time from Night to Day

#### Misc

- Robin’s punch is stronger (has same strength as Little John)
- Map 01 (Lincoln) - arrow targets cannot be shot
- Other minor small changes
